limitations: Applies to length-ordered truncations of one positive-excursion Dyck code and supplies only asymptotic o(1) error in the scaled deficit. Earlier equivalent quantitative renewal calculations remain a priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Finite tests are corroborative only; the theorem is derived from a complete analytic renewal and Laplace argument. No external independent validation has been performed.
title: Sharp logarithmic finite-core entropy deficit for primitive Dyck excursions
